title: Pendant Overrun
source: Engine-ready authored setup/solution for this pass; canonical A01 solution is in canon_reference. No decoded GBA fixed-board table was available when this script was authored.
notes: Black Pendant gives +500 ATK, turning 2500 into exactly 3000.

canon_reference.setup_status: unknown in A01; this pass ships an engine-ready authored setup
solution_steps: Summon Breaker the Magical Warrior and activate his effect to destroy Premature Burial, which will take Jinzo down with it.
Set Kozaky's Self-Destruct Button on the field.
Enter Battle Phase and attack the face-down monster with Breaker.
